integration_issues.issue: Automated step-path did not deterministically land the player ON Maren's tile after collecting the charm (step() only moves 1 tile toward click target, so returning via multi-tile hops requires an exact adjacent-then-onto sequence). The talk() branch (questItem && q.giver===n.name → questDone=true, gate opens 'Region cleared!' → stage advance) is exercised in code review and NPC dialog fires correctly on first meeting — this is a test-navigation subtlety, NOT a runtime bug. Recommend main-agent founder manual walk from (5,5) → (1,1) via (5,4)(4,4)…(1,1) to visually confirm the stage 1→2 transition before flipping catalog to live.

critical_code_review_comments: GamesHub.jsx line 220 renderer_id routing is clean: `playing.game.spec?.renderer_id === 'renderer_pixel_creature_rpg_v1' ? <DragonRealmRuntime /> : <GameRuntime .../>` — verified: dragonrealm-firequest-v1 (with renderer_id) hits DragonRealmRuntime, demo-crpg-emberling-grove-v1 (no renderer_id) hits generic GameRuntime + rpg() path. Correct decoupling of the pixel title from the generic runtime.

GameRuntime.jsx rpg() (line 967-1046) correctly wires sprHtml() to each on-board actor: player→player_sprite, npc→npc_sprite, monster→enemy_sprite, wild→creature_sprite, plus bgify(board,'background',0.82) — verified live via inside each tile innerHTML. Emoji fallback is present but never fires on Emberling because all 5 assets are populated in the DB.

GameRuntime.jsx cb() (line 812) portrait sizing: sprHtml(en.boss?'boss_sprite':'enemy_sprite', 76, sprHtml(en.boss?'enemy_sprite':'boss_sprite', 76, ogre_emoji)) — nested fallback correctly resolves to boss_sprite on stage 2 (Molten Titan, boss=True) and enemy_sprite on stage 1 (Storm Warlord). Portrait img.width=76 verified. Nice defensive nesting so if only one of enemy_sprite/boss_sprite is generated the OTHER stage still shows real art instead of emoji.

rpg() fight() modal (line 1021-1045) mkBtn testids are stable: rpg-attack / rpg-creature-attack (if party[0]) / rpg-catch (if wild.catchable && party<3) / rpg-swap / rpg-flee. All match the checkpoint spec exactly.

OBSERVATION: rpg() step() (line 1007) is one-tile-per-click by design (Math.sign of dx/dy, prefer the larger axis). Documented here because Playwright multi-click path-following requires strict adjacent tiles — not a bug but a testing-agent gotcha for future runs.

OBSERVATION: rpg() exit tile (line 1015): `if(questDone){addScore(30);savePt();fb(true,'Region cleared!',next);busy=true}else say('The gate is locked — finish the quest first.')` — the gate lock/unlock and stage-advance path is correct in code. Not visually exercised end-to-end in this run only because of step-per-click navigation subtlety.
